No compatibility owner or alternate graph type introduced.

Injected exact exception instances from each existing native factory propagate unchanged and a following real export succeeds; mutex/cache lifecycle unchanged.

Faithful staged amplitude(...).generate().build() migration; explicitly indexes lazy diagrams instead of unsupported slicing. No assertion, owner, rendering/export path or callback removed/skipped. All 3 unittest cases and all their subtests execute on real installed native owners. Independently read frozen source31 log: the same 3 cases previously failed on removed Process.generate_diagrams; full log records 113 tests, 3 errors, 6 unrelated skips.

All 22 files audited individually against original source35 and current TensorReducer/TensorExpression/native producer boundaries. Scalar default prefactors convert to ordinary algebra; reducer results convert where the remaining consumer uses plain algebra; muon/identical-lepton contractions deliberately stay tensor-aware through to_dots/is_scalar.
